candidates.snippet: At least three children and one adult were killed in a shooting at an elementary school in Bend, Oregon, according to preliminary information from a law enforcement source. https://t.co/Be3xjmceCC

Multiple people, including children, were injured and a shooter is dead after gunfire erupted at an elementary school in Bend, Oregon, on Thursday, according to police. The shooter had already been shot and killed inside the school when police arrived at the scene at about 1 p.m.

BREAKING: Multiple people were injured, including children, and the suspect is dead after an active shooter situation at an elementary school in Bend, Oregon, according to police.
